svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Muse Code from Claude Code: one real session, three substitutions
svg.desc: One recorded session of the plugin against Meta’s Muse Code 1.3.0. Each scene is the unedited stdout and stderr of one bridge command, paired with the slash command a user types. The repository path and home directory are substituted when the demo is built, and the login email was redacted in the capture files themselves.
svg.text: Muse Code from Claude Code: one real session, three substitutions
